name: A Friend
comment: Look at what I have to say!

name: Third Parent
comment: This blog is the coolest thing I have ever read.

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: I cant wait to see the underwater videos!

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: I could have danced with all the Gogos all day

name: Gogo
comment: Wow! Aunt Mary has really been busy!  Aunt Olivia and I will be so excited to get our new clothes.

name: Gogo
comment: Hello Mtemba - I am so excited to be able to talk to you about your fantastic Malawi Adventures blog!  I miss you guys, and hearing from you about your week helps me get through the days!

name: Gogo
comment: Your new outfit matching Mom and Dad look great!

name: Gogo
comment: It was very sweet of you to surprise Mom and Amayi with Mother's Day cards.  I know it made them feel special.

name: Joy
comment: Hey everyone!  Love the addition of the comments section!  Mtemba, stop getting so tall!!!  The picture of you and Chiboda standing next to the statue compared to the current one shows how much you have grown!  Speaking of, where is Chiboda?  I don't see any recent pics of him.  I bet he has grown, too.  I hope to see you when you come back to the USA!  Love you, stay safe.

name: Gogo
comment: Wow Mtemba, that sounds like a fun time with Mom's friends!  So many things everyone got to see and do and I don't think that is the whole trip, lol.  I'm glad you got to spend some time with Janet's son, Shama.  It sounds like it made the drive more fun.

name: Gogo
comment: Amayi!  I love your new sewing machine!  I can't wait to see all the things you make :)  Is that a scone picnic on the Conde?  Love their scones!  Sharon makes a great model for Mary's sewing.  She is so pretty.  Mtemba you have always had a great imagination and I am so glad you are having some down time to really explore, create and grow!  Alexandra, I am excited to see all the things you guys come up with for market.  Love the books.  A new Chambo man?  what happened to the other guy?  Miss you guys.

name: Emmanuel Mwandama
comment:
Hi Alexandra,

I love what you guys did on this day. My eyes are always filled with tears of Joy when I receive calls from the village all thanking you for what you did, the impact was too much. Imagine a 80 year old saying “In my entire life I have never received a Blanket, shake Azungu hands, slept on a Mattress,   All this was happened because Alinafe Global Outreach came.

Your visit to Amayi’s Church was life Changing. The Church now is receiving visitors every sunday and the Church is growing. 

Thank you on behalf of my people. Those who want to connect with us reach out through our website www.alinafeglobaloutreach.org

name: Kris Kennet
comment: I'm so amazed and grateful to God for helping these beautiful people. Seeing joy on the faces and hearing it in their songs.

name: Kathy Peterson
comment:
Thank you for the food descriptions, love to hear about the meals you have in Malawi. 
The pool in Eden looks like so much fun! I teach swimming lessons & like to check out pools. 
Keep writing!
